results.description:
This book is the first in The Billionaires Club Series.  Welcome to a debauched world where wealthy men take what they want, and beautiful women cater to their desires.  Lose yourself to steamy fantasy, and let your imagination roam!

The billionaire always gets what he wants.
I didn’t think it was possible.  Troy Black was a rich man who didn’t need to buy girls.  But at the virgin auction, he bought me and suddenly I belonged to the alpha male.

He made it sweet for me though.

I wore his clothes.

Ate the best food.

And slept in a big, fluffy bed.

But everything came with a price …and the billionaire craved me in a way that I never expected.

Hey Readers -- This is a sexy, over-the-top romance that will make your cheeks burn and your panties melt.  Guaranteed HEA with no cheating and no cliffhangers.  You’ll love it, I promise.  Xoxo, Cassie
